metadata.title: Scalar curvature integrals on geodesic balls
metadata.abstract: We study scalar curvature integrals over geodesic balls on complete noncompact manifolds. Under nonnegative Ricci curvature and rotational symmetry, we prove the sharp bound \[ \int_{B_p(r)}S\text{d}\mu_g \le 2n(n-1)\omega_n \bigl(1-v^{1/(n-1)}\bigr)r^{n-2}, \] when $p$ is the rotational origin. Here $\omega_n$ is the volume of the Euclidean unit ball and $v=V_{M^n}$ is the asymptotic volume ratio. In dimension three, with the center at a pole, we obtain a sharp bound \[ \int_{B_p(r)}S\text{d}\mu_g\le16\pi r, \] without any positive volume growth assumption. We also obtain a bound for every asymptotic volume ratio which is sharp for $0\le v\le1/4$. Under nonnegative sectional curvature and $v>0$, we prove the explicit bound at arbitrary centers \[ \int_{B_p(r)}S\text{d}\mu_g\le12\pi(1-v)v^{-3}r. \] If $0\le1-v\le1/100$, we further obtain \[ \int_{B_p(r)}S\text{d}\mu_g\le\bigl[8\pi(1-v)+200\pi(1-v)^2\bigr]r. \] The leading coefficient $8\pi$ is sharp, and a remainder of quadratic order in $1-v$ is necessary.

analysis.workSummary: 研究非紧流形测地球上的标量曲率积分与渐近体积比 v 的关系，区分旋转对称及任意中心情形。
analysis.breakthrough: Ricci 非负的旋转对称情形给出尖锐 rⁿ⁻² 型上界；三维还获得极点中心的 16πr 界及非负截面曲率下任意中心的定量估计。
analysis.limitations: 旋转对称估计以旋转中心为球心；任意中心估计需更强的截面曲率非负及 v>0，不能交换这些假设。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 常数、体积亏损与不同对称条件的关系明确。
